title: Die Leere zwischen den Zeilen — an essay laid out as drifting fragments
note: The essay text is not a column. Short fragments sit all over the page at different indents, some lines pushed far right, a single vertical hairline runs the full length, and words drift apart as you scroll: "Angst" is spaced into "A   n   g   s   t" across 400px, and a sentence about connection rises and tilts word by word ("Kontakte zu knüpfen ist einfach…"). All in the same 16px pixel mono. Worth reusing: letting the spacing carry the meaning of an essay (gaps for emptiness, drifting for falling apart) instead of illustrations.
